retrievalProfile.description: A multi-subject group portrait featuring high-contrast urban fashion against a stark white background with massive, geometric display typography integrated behind the subjects.
triggerTerms: pyramidal group portrait with large background text
excludeWhen: a natural outdoor setting is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A dynamic group of eight young men in eclectic urban fashion arranged in a tiered, pyramidal formation. The lighting is bright and flat, casting minimal shadows against a pure white void. A massive, black, geometric sans-serif title dominates the upper third, partially obscured by the subjects to create depth.
coreVisualRelationships: Subjects overlap the background typography to create a 3D layering effect.
High-contrast black and white elements anchor the colorful, textured streetwear.
A central vertical axis is formed by the tiered arrangement of the group members.
coreInvariants: Pure white background with no environmental details.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Eight subjects arranged in three tiers (top, middle, bottom) filling the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure in the middle tier and the massive black lettering at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large top text, moves down through the central column of faces, and fans out to the peripheral members.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Stark white space at the top corners and between the large letterforms.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Electric Blue, Pink, and Yellow (Fashion Accents)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value background with high-saturation clothing accents against neutral black and white bases.

letterConstructionRules: Closed counters with minimal internal space
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' features a high horizontal bar and a pointed apex.
The 'R' has a sharp, diagonal leg meeting the vertical stem at a high point.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme scale contrast between a massive, stylized display font and a small, legible metadata font.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary vertical weight and condensed structure.
To achieve the specific 45-degree chamfered corners.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a group of eight young men in diverse urban streetwear (jackets, beanies, chains) arranged in a tiered pyramid sitting on a white bench against a pure white background. Leave the top third of the frame empty for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a massive, vertically stretched, black geometric sans-serif title in the top third, ensuring the heads of the top-row subjects overlap the bottom of the letters. Add a small line of bold sans-serif text centered at the very bottom.

verificationChecks: Does the top text appear behind the subjects' heads?
Are the corners of the display text angular and sharp?
Is the group arranged in a clear tiered formation?

mustRedesign: Identifiable facial features of specific celebrities
postGenerationChecks: Check that the display text is vertically elongated.
Ensure the white background is consistent and blown out.
Verify the subjects are layered in front of the large text.
Confirm the bottom metadata text is legible and centered.
recipe.reuseFormula: Tiered Group Portrait + Massive Background Typography + High-Contrast Urban Aesthetic
